summary: Meta announced the 30 recipients of its AI Glasses Impact Grant program, awarding nearly $2 million to organizations building applications for Ray-Ban Meta and other AI glasses in workforce, accessibility, education and agriculture use cases.

practices.reason: Third-party developers integrating apps via Meta's Device Access Toolkit signals an app integration surface for glasses, but no technical detail is given to act on.
practices.quote: Catalyst Grant recipients will integrate their apps on Ray-Ban Meta glasses later this year
